description: This file defines the LoginMethodController class with methods for managing login methods, including creation, retrieval, updating, and testing configurations, within an enterprise application using Express.js.

classes.name: LoginMethodController
classes.description: Controller class handling login method operations such as create, read, update, and test configuration for enterprise login integrations.

methods.name: assertEnterprisePlatform
methods.description: Checks if the current platform is enterprise; throws error if not.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new login method based on request body.

methods.name: defaultMethods
methods.description: Retrieves default login methods for an organization or platform.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads login method configuration by ID or organization ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates login method configuration and initializes SSO providers.

methods.name: testConfig
methods.description: Tests login provider setup for Azure, Google, Auth0, or Github.
